verdict.rationale: Embedding a framework into an existing server-rendered page is a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents doing this with Angular. There is nothing on mounting components into existing markup, custom elements, or progressive enhancement. Community notes about integrating jQuery plugins or D3 into Angular describe the reverse direction and do not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the framework into an existing server-rendered HTML page and render interactive components without rewriting the whole page
